title: These 4 Stocks Are Seeing Massive Institutional Buying
creator: MarketBeat
summary: MarketBeat's Bridget hosts Louis Navellier of InvestorPlace's Growth Investor to highlight four stocks riding Nvidia's AI wave and seeing heavy institutional buying. Navellier opens with Nvidia itself - forecasting 100% sales growth for 2027 led by the Vera Rubin chip (5x faster, 10x more energy-efficient, shipping Q4) - calling it 'a safe hold to the end of the decade' he could never sell. His four picks: Micron (MU), 'one of the most powerful stocks we own' - next-quarter sales forecast +138.4% and earnings +254.6%, analyst estimates more than doubled in 90 days, a candidate for 'the new Magnificent 7'; Seagate Technology (STX), his favorite disk-drive name - next-quarter sales +36%, earnings +82%, a consistent earnings-surprise record, and still-reasonable forward P/Es for a memory stock that has run from $63 to over $400 in a year; Ciena (CIEN, caption 'Sienna'), newly added to the S&P 500 - optical networking for data centers, with sales +33.5% and earnings +247% expected, though midcap volatility ('sits, it hops'); and Ubiquiti (UI), the networking-switch maker whose institutional and data-center business is booming. Navellier warns 2026 looks strong ('lock and load') but expects momentum to decelerate and profit-taking in 2027 as backlogs normalize, and on quantum computing says Nvidia - not these names - would be the winner if it commercializes. No MarketBeat (Bridget) calls - all stock calls are the guest's (host-only). Note: 'Sienna' = Ciena (CIEN); 'Navalier' = Navellier; Ubiquiti ticker given as 'UI'.
